cli.intro: open-voice — vocal synthesis library and CLI
cli.cmd.sing: Sing a spec file into a WAV (positional: <spec.json>)
cli.cmd.demo: Render the built-in demo melody into a WAV
cli.cmd.validate: Validate a spec file without rendering (positional: <spec.json>)
cli.cmd.verify: Render to a temporary WAV and check duration, level and clipping (positional: <spec.json>)
cli.cmd.info: Print native version and the vowel/onset contract tables
cli.opt.tempo: Override the spec tempo in BPM
cli.opt.transpose: Transpose every syllable by a number of semitones
